title: The Uplift on an Equipment Rental and Demo Change Fee for What Is at Stake in the Kit
content:
Changing dear kit costs the shop more than changing cheap kit, and the change fee on an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement carries an uplift where the security hold standing against the agreement says the kit is dear.

## The rule

Where the security hold standing against the agreement is at or above 120.00 USD, and the agreement was written for at least the package's multi-day threshold in days, the fee is raised by the high value uplift. The high value uplift is 30 per cent.

Where the security hold standing against the agreement is at or above 120.00 USD and the agreement was written for fewer days than the package's multi-day threshold, the fee is raised by the mid value uplift instead. The mid value uplift is 15 per cent.

In any other case the fee carries no uplift under this heading.

## The package thresholds this rule reads

| Package | Multi-day threshold, days |
| --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 3 |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 3 |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 3 |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 3 |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 2 |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 1 |

## The two conditions in combination

| Security hold standing against the agreement | Days the agreement was written for | Uplift |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 120.00 USD or more | at least the package's threshold | 30 per cent |
| 120.00 USD or more | fewer than the package's threshold | 15 per cent |
| below 120.00 USD | either way | none under this heading |

A hold standing at exactly 120.00 USD is at the figure and opens one of the first two rows. A number of days the agreement was written for exactly equal to the package's threshold is at least that threshold and takes the first.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical change

Take a Sport Ski & Board Rental agreement, whose multi-day threshold is 3 days, on which the change fee comes to 12.00 USD before this heading.

- The hold standing is 250.00 USD and the agreement was written for 5 days: the fee is raised by 30 per cent, which gives 15.60 USD.
- The hold standing is 250.00 USD and the agreement was written for 2 days: the fee is raised by 15 per cent, which gives 13.80 USD.
- The hold standing is 100.00 USD: the fee carries no uplift under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**What the hold standing is.** It is what was placed against the agreement less what has already gone back, not the figure the package carries on the schedule.
